tone: Premium, artistic, emotionally appealing, calm, cinematic

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24, py-32 for sections. gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.
layout_strategy.hero: Cinematic 2x2 grid. 4 square cards covering full height/width, changing images smoothly. Center overlay content.
layout_strategy.grids: Bento grids with asymmetry for 'What I Do'. Rigid structured card grid for 'Services'.
layout_strategy.navigation: Crystal glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60 border-b border-white/5) or solid dark.

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle scale (scale-105) on images with long duration (duration-700) and ease-out. Dimming non-hovered siblings in grids.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Parallax on hero grids, sticky scroll for 'My Approach' timeline.

components.buttons: Flat, thin borders. Primary CTA: bg-primary text-[#050505] hover:bg-white transition-colors duration-300. Secondary: border border-white/20 text-white hover:border-white/50.
components.cards: Cardless or minimal 1px border. Deep blacks, no heavy drop shadows. Rely on image contrast.
components.forms: Minimal inputs, border-b only, floating labels, bg-transparent. Accent peach for focus states.
components.admin_dashboard: Clean, dark mode Shadcn components. Golden active states. Functional, high contrast.

what_i_dont_do.warning_overlay: Apply grayscale and a muted #8A3D3D (dark red/peach blend) 40% overlay on chaotic background images to visually demonstrate what is avoided.

home.hero: 2x2 grid with framer-motion AnimatePresence for auto-rotating the 4 media items. Content overlaid in center.
home.what_i_dont_do: High contrast section, muted warning tone. Text-heavy with subtle, darkened, blurred background.
home.my_approach: Sticky timeline or 3-4 aesthetic blocks revealing on scroll.

pages.services: Grid of pricing cards. Crisp typography, highlighting duration, edited photos, and price.
pages.gallery: Masonry or categorized standard grid. Hover to zoom.
pages.booking: Clean contact form with WhatsApp redirect logic.
pages.admin: Protected route. Dashboard using Shadcn tables to list bookings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use placeholder text or generic placeholder images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure all interactive elements have a data-testid attribute.
Implement the 2x2 rotating hero grid with framer-motion.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout flexibility, and Shadcn for the Admin Dashboard and Booking form.
Strictly adhere to the dark theme luxury color palette provided.
Do not use transparent header without a blur or scrim.
